title: Brad Brisco — applies Eric's Polaroid story to churches and institutional decline
summary: Brad Brisco — author and Director of Bivocational Church Planting at NAMB — uses Eric's Polaroid case study from Incorruptible to make a parallel argument about how churches and institutions decline when they stop creating, experimenting, and adapting. 448 views on X.
blockquote: In the book "Incorruptible," author Eric Ries tells the story of Polaroid to illustrate that no organization can live indefinitely on yesterday's successes. Even institutions built on innovation can slowly decline when they stop creating, experimenting, and adapting.
attribution_title: Author; Director of Bivocational Church Planting, North American Mission Board
